tokens.name: palette-blue
tokens.usage: Samlytics primary blue for all UI. The supplied logo artwork renders its blue brighter (about #1E85FB): leave the logo as supplied, but never sample UI colours from the logo image.

tokens.name: palette-navy
tokens.usage: Samlytics primary navy (the brand's 'black'). Reference only.

tokens.name: palette-cream
tokens.usage: Samlytics primary cream. Reference only.

tokens.name: palette-lime
tokens.usage: Samlytics secondary lime. Reference only.

tokens.name: palette-lime-deep
tokens.usage: Samlytics secondary deep lime. Reference only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for every screen except the recording screen.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets and list rows on surface. A tint of the brand blue in light, a lift of navy in dark.

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Large brand fields: onboarding panels, empty states, the export success screen. Text on it is on-brand.

tokens.name: live-surface
tokens.usage: The recording screen in BOTH themes ('house lights down'). Text on it is on-live-surface.

tokens.name: live-raised
tokens.usage: Buttons and dividers on live-surface: the Pause button, the Photo, Bookmark and Note buttons (cream on it 13.0:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on surface and surface-raised (16.7:1 light, 16.7:1 and 13.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, timestamps, helper text on surface and surface-raised (light 5.5:1 and 5.0:1, dark 7.7:1 and 6.0:1). Never on brand-tint (fails): use ink there.

tokens.name: on-live-surface
tokens.usage: Text and icons on live-surface (16.7:1).

tokens.name: on-live-surface-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on live-surface: storage estimate, input route (7.7:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected states, progress fills, large display words (24px+), icons. NEVER body text on cream: 3.15:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on brand fills below 19px Bold (5.3:1). For primary buttons use on-brand-large.

tokens.name: on-brand-large
tokens.usage: Cream labels on brand fills, as in the supplied screens ('Get started', 'Export conference'). Only at 19px Bold or larger, where 3.15:1 meets the large-text rule.

tokens.name: brand-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill, active list row. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, always underlined. Light uses navy because brand blue fails on cream at text size.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Recording is ON: the live dot, the record ring, the timer accent. Only ever on live-surface or navy (14.7:1). Never on cream (1.1:1).

tokens.name: on-live
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a live (lime) fill (14.7:1).

tokens.name: stop
tokens.usage: The red square of the Stop control on live-surface only, as in the supplied recording screen (4.5:1 on navy). Never for anything else. Not a Samlytics palette colour: functional exception.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, exported and verified badges as a FILL with on-success text. Always paired with a word or a tick.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on success fills (11.9:1).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Delete, storage critical, errors. Functional colour outside the Samlytics palette (5.6:1 light, 7.4:1 dark). The Stop control uses stop, not danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Low-storage and low-battery banners. Text on it is ink. Always with an icon and a sentence.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between list rows. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, outlined buttons and toggles (3:1 or more on surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring with 2px offset on every focusable element (3.15:1 on cream, 5.3:1 on navy).

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Conference name on its home screen. Montserrat Bold (brand board: headings). One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles: 'My conferences', 'Session review', 'Export to cloud'. Montserrat Bold.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Subheadings and activity titles. Montserrat Semibold (brand board: subheadings).

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Recording paused for a call. It will carry on when you hang up.
styles.usage: Default text. Montserrat Regular (brand board: body text).

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Metadata lines in cards: place, dates, duration. Montserrat Regular.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, tabs, bottom navigation. Montserrat Semibold. Primary buttons with cream text go up to 19px.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Small labels under icons ('Photo', 'Bookmark', 'Note') and technical details. Montserrat Medium (brand board: captions).

styles.name: timer
styles.usage: Elapsed time on the recording screen. Use tabular figures so digits do not jump.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Totals on conference home and Storage Manager.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, between a title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner padding of chips and small buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections, card padding on tablets and Surface.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap above a screen title, around the record button.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Large breathing room on onboarding and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large panels and hero tiles, echoing the logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, status pills, the record ring. The brand's pill motif.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target on every control.

tokens.name: record-button
tokens.usage: Diameter of the record button.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size, 2px stroke.

shadow.note: Samlytics is flat. Separate with surface-raised and line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets only, so they lift off the screen behind.
